    Multiple Group Statistical Analysis and Visualization

    multi_groups_analysis.Rd

    Performs statistical analysis for more than two groups, including parametric or non-parametric tests, post-hoc comparisons, and generates bar, box, and violin plots with error bars and significance annotations.

    multi_groups_analysis(
  value_column,
  grouping_column,
  data,
  bar_queue = NaN,
  x_label = "",
  x_angle = 30,
  y_label = "",
  size = 10,
  bar_size = 0.5,
  parametric = FALSE,
  include_ns = FALSE,
  bars = "sem",
  bars_size = 1,
  adjustment.method = "bonferroni",
  stat_plot_ratio = 0.2,
  stat_hight = 10,
  y_break = NaN,
  brew_colors = "Dark2"
)

    Arguments

    value_column

    Character. Name of the column in `data` representing numeric values to be compared.

    grouping_column

    Character. Name of the column in `data` representing grouping factor.

    data

    Data frame. The dataset containing `value_column` and `grouping_column`.

    bar_queue

    Optional character vector. Custom order of groups for plotting (must match group names).

    x_label

    Character. Label for the x-axis.

    x_angle

    Numeric. Angle for x-axis text labels (default = 30).

    y_label

    Character. Label for the y-axis.

    size

    Numeric. Font size for axis titles (default = 10).

    bar_size

    Numeric. Width of the bars and boxes (default = 0.5).

    parametric

    Logical. If TRUE, uses parametric tests (ANOVA + t-test); if FALSE, uses Kruskal-Wallis + Wilcoxon / Mann-Whitney test.

    include_ns

    Logical. If FALSE, excludes non-significant comparisons from plot.

    bars

    Character. Error bars type: `"sem"` (default) or `"sd"`.

    bars_size

    Numeric. Thickness of error bars (not currently used).

    adjustment.method

    Character. Method for p-value adjustment in post-hoc test (e.g., `"bonferroni"`, `"holm"`).

    stat_plot_ratio

    Numeric. Relative height of significance plot above main plot (default = 0.2).

    stat_hight

    Numeric. Controls spacing between significance brackets (default = 10).

    y_break

    Numeric. Break interval for y-axis. If NA, default ggplot scale is used.

    brew_colors

    Character. RColorBrewer palette name (default = `"Dark2"`).

    Value

    An S4 object of class `multi_groups_analysis` with the following slots:

    violin_plot

    ggplot object — violin plot with error bars.

    bar_plot

    ggplot object — bar plot with error bars.

    box_plot

    ggplot object — box plot with error bars.

    statistic_tests

    S4 object — result of group tests (ANOVA/KW + post-hoc).

    statistic_data

    data.frame — summary statistics (mean, SEM, SD) for each group.

    statistic_txt_resum

    Character — textual summary of statistical results.

    avg_FC_results

    data.frame — fold-change comparisons between groups.

    Details

    This function is designed for exploratory data analysis involving multiple groups. It automatically handles appropriate statistical tests based on the `parametric` flags, formats plots, and annotates p-values with asterisks.

    If only 2 groups are detected, an error is returned recommending the use of `two_groups_analysis()`.

    Examples

    result <- multi_groups_analysis(
  value_column = "Score",
  grouping_column = "Group",
  data = my_data,
  parametric = TRUE,
  bar_queue = c("Control", "Treatment1", "Treatment2"),
  x_label = "Groups",
  y_label = "Response",
  include_ns = FALSE
)
#> Error: object 'my_data' not found
result@bar_plot
#> Error: object 'result' not found
result@statistic_txt_resum
#> Error: object 'result' not found
